notes: External site, first stage: spark-ds41f-1030 at tp4-ring on the stock 4 KiB kernel 6.17.0-1032-nvidia without the memory saver (started with --unqualified-shape). Serves stock DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 rev 1bae0e10 from a snapshot whose shards link over read-only NFS to the head's copy (shards 47/48, the Engram tables, local on every node) as one name; the GLP second name is unset; 64 images per prompt (chat clients resend history images). Batch budget 8,192 (long-prefill threshold 8,096), the r6u value. host.fan_control false: the boards are ASUS Ascent GX10, not NVIDIA's P4242. Site policy: scripts/memguard.sh warns instead of killing the container.

site-1017.notes: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 rev 1bae0e10, every LFS file sha256-verified; workers read the blobs over read-only NFS from the head, Engram shards 47/48 local.
